description: CQUAD4 simply-supported beam modal: 10-element mesh, first bending ~22.9 Hz

checks.comment: Mode 1: first bending. Analytical (SS beam): f1 = (pi/L)^2/(2*pi)*sqrt(EI/rhoA) ~= 22.9 Hz. FE: 23.2 Hz.

Mode 2: in-plane bending. Both left grids fix T1, so the in-plane beam is clamped-pinned: f = (3.9266/pi)^2 * 22.9 ~= 35.8 Hz analytically; one element across the width gives 38.3 Hz. (The earlier CQUAD4 membrane locked in in-plane bending and pushed this mode above 130 Hz.)
Mode 3: second out-of-plane bending, ~4 x f1 = 91.6 Hz for an SS beam (plate stiffness and mesh raise it).
